intro.title: Daily Ops - Daily Ops Boss Stats
intro.blurb: Each Daily Op pits you against one rotating enemy family, and every family ends in a boss fight. This page lists each family's boss and variant bosses, their weapons, health and damage, the Daily Ops mutation pool, and the enemies that support them. All numbers are read from the game files and update with every patch.
intro.profiles: One enemy family is active per Op. Its boss and any variant bosses are listed below.
intro.mutations: Every Daily Op applies one mutation to its enemies, drawn from the pool below. On Double Mutated days a combined mutation from the second list is used instead.
intro.mechanics: Boss stats that apply across the Daily Ops enemy families.
intro.health: Health is read from the curve table assigned to each boss across the Daily Ops boss level range.
intro.damage: Damage per hit from each boss's hardest-hitting weapon, at the bottom and top of its level range.
intro.support: Support creatures spawn alongside each family's humanoid enemies.

mutations.intro: Every Daily Op applies one mutation to its enemies, drawn from the pool below. On Double Mutated days a combined mutation from the second list is used instead.

list.name: Volatile
list.detail: Explodes when killed — back off before the last hit lands.

list.name: Active Camouflage
list.detail: Invisible by default; becomes visible while firing or attacking.

list.name: Resilient
list.summary: Can only be killed by a melee attack
list.detail: Cannot be killed by ranged damage — the final blow has to be a melee hit.

list.name: Freezing Touch
list.detail: Melee hits trigger a cryo burst — Chilled, then Frozen on repeated hits, slowing you until you are immobilised.

list.name: Toxic Blood
list.detail: Leaves a poison hazard on the ground when killed.

list.name: Group Regeneration
list.summary: Heals while grouped in close proximity
list.detail: Heals while grouped up with allies in close range — pull enemies apart.

list.name: Swift-Footed
list.detail: Moves faster and reloads much quicker.

list.name: Danger Cloud
list.summary: Harms HP and AP of nearby players
list.detail: Periodically releases a poison cloud that damages health and drains Action Points of players caught inside it.

list.name: Reflective Skin
list.summary: Periodically reflects direct damage to its source
list.detail: Reflects part of the damage it takes back to the attacker on a timed cycle. It glows briefly before the reflect window opens.

mutations.doubleIntro: Double Mutated days combine two effects into one of these.

double.name: Stinging Frost
double.summary: Freezing attacks and toxic hazard on death

double.name: Relentless
double.summary: Heals in proximity and killed only by melee

double.name: Unstable
double.summary: Extra fast and explodes on death

double.name: Vaporous
double.summary: Cloaking ability and explodes on death

double.name: Chilling Mend
double.summary: Heals in proximity and freezing attacks

double.name: Clouded Toxins
double.summary: Cloaking ability and toxic hazard on death
